scientific_limitations: Restricted to Petersen graph perfect-matching subcomplex and its natural S5 action; ordinary nonequivariant wedge rank is already implied by known matching incidence and standard nerve methods; unindexed equivalent equivariant computations remain a bibliographic risk; no assertion of an integral irreducible lattice direct sum.
title: An equivariant graph spine for the Petersen perfect-matching complex
